cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation

cases.expected: Keep uploaded file and preference inputs if Docling fails or the user steps back.

cases.title: Connection drops while waiting
cases.question: Does the wait resume, restart or fail silently?
cases.expected: Queue parsing locally and notify the user in Telegram once the 28 bullets are ready.

cases.title: The thing being waited for never arrives
cases.question: Is there a time limit and a next step when it runs out?
cases.expected: Set a 30s Docling timeout; on expiry, offer plain-text fallback or manual bullet paste.

cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation

cases.expected: Preserve entered target titles/comp if passphrase validation fails, and wipe passphrase from Telegram chat history immediately.

cases.title: Two-column PDF merges unrelated columns into bullets
cases.question: How does the user detect and fix merged column text before locking verified bullets?
cases.expected: Flag low-confidence layout parses and let the user edit or drop individual bullets before verification.

cases.step_name: Reviews extracted bullets & approves verified facts
cases.title: Candidate resume has fewer than 15 bullets
cases.question: Activation target mentions >=15 verified bullets. Are junior candidates with 8-12 bullets blocked from activating?

cases.step_name: Sets AES-256 passphrase & target role/comp preferences
cases.title: Passphrase typed into Telegram chat persists in chat history
cases.question: Where is the AES-256 passphrase entered so Telegram cloud servers never see it?
cases.expected: Derive the key via local CLI / OS Keychain or local webview, never as a plaintext Telegram message.

cases.title: Signed out while in the flow
cases.question: After signing in again, do they return to where they were?
cases.expected: Save partially verified bullets (is_verified = 0) in SQLite so returning users resume at verify_bullets instead of re-uploading.
